label: 区域偏压缩
description: 以区域自身八个方位（北/东北/东/东南/南/西南/西/西北）的边界锚点为受力点，对区域做局部有符号形变，效果类似揉面团：每个方位独立设置力度，正数=压缩（该方位附近边界向内收缩），负数=拉伸（向外扩张），力度按距离平滑衰减，0=不施力。锚点按区域重心+方位投影自动定位，支持异形/非凸自然边界。拉伸受当前画布内已有背景余量限制（与 alg_region_offset 外扩同一约束）。
description-en: Applies a signed local deformation to a region using anchor points auto-located at the region's eight compass directions (N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW), like kneading dough: each direction has an independent strength, positive squeezes the boundary inward, negative stretches it outward, decaying smoothly with distance, 0 = no force. Anchors are found via centroid + directional projection, so irregular/non-convex natural boundaries are supported. Outward stretch is bounded by existing background room in the working canvas (same constraint as alg_region_offset's dilation).
icon: 深色背景上一个不规则有机形状，边缘八个方向各有一个小箭头/手指按压或拉伸出的凹凸波浪痕迹，形成不对称的挤压变形轮廓，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: region
inputs.label: 输入区域
inputs.description: 0/1（或多值）区域网格；非零格视为前景。支持任意异形/不规则形状。
inputs.description-en: 0/1 (or multi-valued) region grid; non-zero cells are foreground. Any irregular shape is supported.

inputs.name: north
inputs.label: 北（N）力度
inputs.description: 区域最北侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's northmost boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: northeast
inputs.label: 东北（NE）力度
inputs.description: 区域最东北侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's northeast boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: east
inputs.label: 东（E）力度
inputs.description: 区域最东侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's east boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: southeast
inputs.label: 东南（SE）力度
inputs.description: 区域最东南侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's southeast boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: south
inputs.label: 南（S）力度
inputs.description: 区域最南侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's south boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: southwest
inputs.label: 西南（SW）力度
inputs.description: 区域最西南侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's southwest boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: west
inputs.label: 西（W）力度
inputs.description: 区域最西侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's west boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: northwest
inputs.label: 西北（NW）力度
inputs.description: 区域最西北侧边界锚点的力度。正=压缩（内收），负=拉伸（外扩），0=不施力。
inputs.description-en: Strength at the region's northwest boundary anchor. Positive = squeeze inward, negative = stretch outward, 0 = no force.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.label: 影响半径
inputs.description: 每个方位锚点的力影响范围（格数）。范围内按平滑曲线衰减到 0，范围外不受影响；多个方位的影响自然叠加过渡。
inputs.description-en: Influence radius (cells) around each compass anchor. Falls off smoothly to 0 within the radius; no effect beyond it. Multiple directions blend naturally where they overlap.

inputs.name: connectivity
inputs.label: 邻接方式
inputs.description: 距离场计算用的邻接方式。4=菱形（曼哈顿），8=方块（含对角，默认，形变边界更顺滑）。
inputs.description-en: Adjacency used for the distance transform. 4 = diamond (Manhattan), 8 = square incl. diagonals (default, smoother boundary).

outputs.name: region
outputs.label: 形变后区域
outputs.description: 形变后的 0/1 区域网格，与输入同形状。
outputs.description-en: Deformed 0/1 region grid; same shape as the input.

outputs.name: delta
outputs.label: 变化标记
outputs.description: -1=被压缩移除的格，+1=被拉伸新增的格，0=未变化；可用于可视化/调试形变范围。
outputs.description-en: -1 = cell removed by squeeze, +1 = cell added by stretch, 0 = unchanged; useful for visualizing/debugging the deformation extent.
